keyPoints: Subscription-scope deployment — all resources land in a single resource group
Managed Identity role assignments are defined alongside the resources that need them
Container Registry uses admin credentials (not Managed Identity) for simplicity
Log Analytics workspace is shared by momentum-finder, trail-finder, and dashboard-api
Scaling rules on Container Apps: min 0 replicas (scale to zero), max 10
arch-content-foundry OpenAI resource uses GlobalStandard SKU with 50K TPM capacity
gpt-5.3-codex model for ideas-bot is deployed separately to mitigate quota constraints
Azure Table Storage is used by ideas-api for project resolution and backfill operations, supporting features like name-based project linkage and one-time data backfill scripts
history-api runs on a Flex Consumption plan, required for Go-based Azure Functions during public preview
history-api uses EasyAuth with an App Registration for secure authentication and authorization
Dedicated storage account for history-api includes versions table and history-attachments blob container
posts-api integrates with history-api using HISTORY_API_URL and HISTORY_API_KEY for version history and storage functionality
posts-api includes Application Insights integration for backend request telemetry, with a dedicated Log Analytics workspace for HTTP request monitoring

running-app is NOT provisioned by main.bicep — it deploys via a separate subscription-scope template in this same repo with its own resource group and region; treat it as an independent deployment pipeline sharing only the repo, not the resource group

daily-api has its own storage account with the DailyChecklist, DailyLinks and DailyCards tables (moved off posts-api's account when daily-api was split out on 2026-10-22); CORS allows only https://www.quixotry.me
New Function Apps must use Flex Consumption (FC1), like history-api and daily-api: a new Linux Y1 consumption plan is refused in my-website-prod-rg ("Dynamic SKU, Linux Worker not available")
Bicep replaces a Function App's whole appSettings list on every deploy, so every setting an app needs must be declared in its module; anything set by hand in the portal is wiped by the next deploy
architecture.overview: Modular Bicep files deployed at subscription scope. Each service has its own module. The Container App Environment module creates the shared Log Analytics workspace used for unified observability across all Container Apps. The arch-content-foundry module provisions an OpenAI resource with a GPT-4o deployment for the arch-content-update CI workflow. The gpt-5.3-codex model for ideas-bot is deployed independently to avoid quota-related deployment failures impacting the rest of the infrastructure. Additionally, Azure Table Storage is provisioned and utilized by ideas-api for project resolution and backfill operations, ensuring robust data consistency and integrity for project and idea management workflows. Posts-api integrates with history-api for version-history storage, requiring HISTORY_API_URL and HISTORY_API_KEY environment variables to enable secure communication. Posts-api now includes Application Insights integration for backend request telemetry, with a dedicated Log Analytics workspace for monitoring HTTP request metrics such as route, method, status, duration, and exceptions. The daily-api module provisions a Flex Consumption (FC1) Function App with its own storage account (DailyChecklist, DailyLinks, DailyCards tables), Application Insights and Log Analytics workspace; new Function Apps use Flex because a new Linux Y1 plan is refused in this resource group.

sublines: Receives HISTORY_API_URL and HISTORY_API_KEY as app settings
Uses history-api for version history and storage operations

dataFlow.label: history-api
sublines: Provides version history and storage services to posts-api
Secured with EasyAuth and a shared write key

dataFlow.label: daily-api
sublines: Receives GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, ALLOWED_WRITERS and DAILY_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING (its own storage account) as app settings
Stores /today's checklist, links and cards in DailyChecklist, DailyLinks and DailyCards

description: Updated to include Application Insights integration for posts-api, providing enhanced telemetry for backend request monitoring and diagnostics. Also provisions [[daily-api|daily-api]] (modules/dailyapi.bicep), which backs /today on its own Flex Consumption Function App and storage account.
features: Integration of Application Insights into posts-api for backend request telemetry, including HTTP route, method, status, duration, and error tracking
Dedicated Log Analytics workspace for posts-api telemetry data, with a 30-day retention period

running-app has its own, wholly separate top-level template (running-app.bicep + modules/runningapp.bicep) — its own resource group, its own region (centralus, vs eastus for everything else), and its own Postgres Flexible Server. main.bicep (this package's primary subscription-scope deployment) never invokes it.

daily-api (modules/dailyapi.bicep): a Python 3.12 Function App on Flex Consumption (FC1, 40 max instances, 2048 MB) with its own storage account holding the DailyChecklist, DailyLinks and DailyCards tables, its own Application Insights (daily-api-prod-insights) and Log Analytics workspace (daily-api-prod-logs), GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / ALLOWED_WRITERS / DAILY_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING app settings, and CORS limited to https://www.quixotry.me
